source: OpenStreetMap, individually looked up via the Nominatim search API during development (2026-10-13)
note: A broader automated sweep (every named lake/peak within the radius via the Overpass API) was attempted first but the public Overpass instance was rate-limiting during development, so this list is a curated set of specific named landmarks individually confirmed to exist in OSM and fall within radiusNm -- not an exhaustive spatial query. Extend it the same way (search, cite the OSM reference, record confidence) rather than guessing coordinates for a name that doesn't turn up a match.

landmarks.name: Moula Ali hill
landmarks.note: Originally pinned via OpenStreetMap's Moula Ali Dargah (place_of_worship) node, the best available proxy since OSM has no separate natural=peak/hill node for Moula Ali. The user independently supplied a Google Maps pin for the hill that landed 66 m from that OSM point -- close enough to treat as the same location and upgrade confidence from medium to high. Coordinates above are the user-provided pin.
